name: lit-best-practices
description: Lit web components best practices for AI agents and LLMs
abstract: Comprehensive best practices guide for Lit web components, designed for AI agents and LLMs. Contains 51 rules across 11 categories, including component structure, rendering, styling, lifecycle, accessibility, performance, reactive controllers, context, testing, and generic custom element interop/API design. Guidance covers value/defaultValue and open/defaultOpen APIs, silent host writes, light-DOM progressive enhancement, property-only rich data, pre-upgrade properties, and browser testing with Playwright or Web Test Runner.
author: community
